key: banyansoftware|atamis director of product and technology
title: Atamis - Director of Product and Technology
jd_excerpt:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

About Atamis

Atamis is a growing software business based in Cardiff. We make source-to-contract procurement software that is trusted across the NHS and the wider public sector, and used by private sector organisations too. We have a strong customer base, a product our customers rely on every working day, and a clear ambition: to move from software that records and reports on procurement to software that does the work.

Every year the UK public sector spends hundreds of billions of pounds buying goods and services, and every pound is taxpayers’ money. Much of that buying is still slow and manual. Buying teams spend their week writing specifications, chasing quotes and justifying decisions, while suppliers, large and small, spend heavily on every bid. Atamis is on a mission to change how that work gets done. As we grow, our team is expanding so we can keep delivering high-quality solutions to our customers.

About the role

You’ll lead Product and Technology as one function and report to the CEO. The big question is how procurement should work if it were designed around AI from scratch: what AI should do, what a person must decide, and how a buyer can trust and defend the result. You’ll answer that question, then build the product and the team that deliver it. You’ll also run the product our customers rely on every working day, with one roadmap and delivery they can plan around.

How software gets built is changing fast, and this role is at the front of it. You’ll rethink how we work from first principles, with AI at the centre. You’ll use AI in your own work every day and work directly with customers.

Key responsibilities

Vision and Strategy

  • Set the product and technology strategy for both our products, and be clear about what we won’t build.
  • Run one roadmap, balancing new capability, customer commitments and technical health.
  • Own the Product and Technology budget, from people to agent, cloud and model spend, and stop what isn’t working.
  • Find the new products and markets AI opens up for our data and procurement knowledge, and prove each one through early releases before we commit fully.

AI

  • Set the limits on how much AI does on its own, what it must prove before it does more, and what always stays with a person.
  • Set the quality bar AI must clear across our products before it reaches customers.
  • Give every use of AI a clear business case and a known cost.

Product and Commercial

  • Lead product management, make sure what our customers tell us shapes what we build, and judge our work by adoption, retention and revenue.
  • Make sure every idea reaches the team as a clear written scope, so product people, engineers and AI agents all start from the same understanding.
  • Work with Sales, Marketing, Delivery, Support and Finance on go-to-market, so product decisions reflect demand and customer value.
  • Be accountable for a standard product that works well out of the box, with as little bespoke work around each customer as possible.

Technology and Delivery

  • Rethink how we build, from idea to release, with AI agents, automated testing and regular releases.
  • Be accountable for predictable, high-quality delivery across our products, and keep the CEO clear on what will ship and when, what it costs, and where we’re off track.
  • Lead large technical change in stages, with clear options and decision points, protecting existing customers throughout.
  • Own technical risk and compliance across our products, from architecture and security to regulation, so the CEO knows the risks we carry and what we’re doing about them.
  • Make the big platform and partner decisions for the company, including how much we depend on any one provider.

People

  • Line manage the Principal Product Manager, the Product Solutions Lead and the Lead Engineers across different locations and time zones, and build a culture of ownership, curiosity and straight talk.
  • Reshape roles, team structure and skills as AI changes the work, hire and develop people, build succession, and keep a way in for junior engineers.
  • Shape company strategy with the leadership team, and represent our direction to customers and partners.

Key requirements

Education

  • A degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

  • 10+ years building B2B software products, including senior leadership of product or development, and enough experience of the other to lead both.
